capabilities: Synchronize the vault with Baidu Netdisk in both directions
Resolve conflicts by keeping local, cloud, both, or skipping
Journal file and folder renames as cloud rename or move operations
Resume four-stage multipart uploads with post-transfer verification
Confirm first-transfer operations in a preview dialog and sync log
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns to keep only one sync plugin active for the same vault and that existing settings from the original plugin are not migrated automatically; setup and usage details are otherwise self-contained in the README.
intentEvidence: It is a modified build of owl234/obsidian-baidu-netdisk-sync under the MIT License
problem: Obsidian's Sync core feature does not cover Baidu Netdisk, and the existing Baidu sync plugin shares a remote index that causes full rescans and loses state on plugin updates.

requires.name: Baidu Open Platform AppKey and AppSecret

summary: Two-way vault sync with Baidu Netdisk using per-device baselines, conflict resolution, explicit rename handling and resumable uploads.
